scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
You... You got younger!!! But you are definitely YOU!
I couldn't think you were able to meet my condition...
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
你...你變年輕了！！！但確實是你本人！
我沒想到你能滿足我的條件...

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Now go forth and get younger!
If you solve my riddle, then I'll give you a magical Jewel Case with a rare accessory.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
現在去吧，去變年輕吧！
如果你能解開我的謎題，我就給你一個裝有稀有飾品的魔法首飾盒。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Seals and return.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你現在很強了。
不過...還沒強到能挑戰我的謎題。
再去消滅{1}只海豹寶寶，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Poporings and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你現在很強了。
不過...還沒強到能挑戰我的謎題。
再去消滅{1}只波波利，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're REALLY strong.
And if you get younger than now I'll give you my treasure.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你現在可真夠強了。
要是還能變得比現在更年輕，我就把寶物給你。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Here is your prize. It's yours for good.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
這是你的獎勵。它永遠屬於你了。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
I've got a riddle for a strong man of 2nd Class and 99 Base Level.
*Yawn* If you meet some, please tell them about my riddle.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
我有一道謎題，想讓Base等級99的二轉強者來解。
*打哈欠* 遇到這樣的人，就幫我轉告一下吧。
